Name: Zedekiah, Son of Josiah
Summary: Third son of Josiah in the kingly line of Judah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:15: Third son of Josiah in the kingly line of Judah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zedekiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
